title: chat-server: unreadCount excludes the owner's messages
description: Per Mark 2026-10-30 (chinwag bead chinwag-dxgx.25, spec bead jmap-chat-spec-vz8p: computation becomes implementation-defined). crate-jmap-chat-server src/chat.rs unread_count (~line 400) counts every message after lastReadMessageId, including the owner's own, so a sender sees their just-sent message as unread. Exclude messages whose senderId is the account owner; apply the same rule to unreadReplyCount. MemoryBackend and maintains_unread_count backends must agree. Needs Mark's approval before writing to crate-jmap.
close_reason: Fixed in ace6da88 + doc fixup 546b188a: unreadCount/unreadReplyCount exclude senderId==accountId; local CI all green (6614 tests stable+beta).
